d:
Mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ki bhavy taiyariyon ko lekar bihar men rajnitik vivad shuru ho gaya hai...aarjedi sansad misa bharti ne shadi ke lie dhan ke srot par saval uthae.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
